slides.teacher_cue: New r-controlled vowel — or makes /ɔː/. Lips rounded and open, tongue mid-back. Like /ɒ/ (short o) but longer and with r-colouring. for, fork, born, corn, sport. Note: 'for' and 'or' are now fully decodable — f+or and just or. These were being avoided before. Now they are available.
slides.expected_response: Students produce /ɔː/ cleanly in or words and understand that or is a new r-controlled vowel.
slides.correction_move: Model the contrast: ox /ɒ/ vs or /ɔː/. Students hear the r lengthening and opening the vowel. Then unlock: for = f+or, or = or — both decodable now.
slides.observation_note: Watch for short /ɒ/ substitution — /ɔː/ is longer and more open. Also watch for /l/ on /r/ in words like corn, sport.
